purpose: Deterministic plan for the locked TOOLSEL exam. Written 2026-11-07 without reading locked.jsonl (only LOCK.json counts/sha were used).
function: TOOLSEL(locked row) = nocall -> `none`; single with len(gold)==1 and gold name in menu -> gold name; multi -> dropped; rows with duplicate tool names, a tool called none, or rendered menu > 5000 chars -> dropped. Output order sha256('toolsel-order|'+id). No sampling, no back-fill.
acceptance: >= 330 per cell (source x kind) and S2 total >= 500; the builder exits non-zero otherwise
run_once: LOCKED_BUILD_OK=1 python build_toolsel.py locked <OUT.jsonl> after the artifact is frozen; commit MANIFEST_locked.json (sha256 of OUT and of sorted id|answer list) BEFORE scoring any model
scorer: toolsel_scorer.py strict_exact: decoded output (special tokens removed) .strip() == answer, nothing else; empty/EOS-only, extra words, quotes, backticks, trailing punctuation, 2 names, case differences are all wrong
s1_stratum_note: locked S1 rows carry stratum unseen|seen; the TOOLSEL rows keep the id so a stratum breakdown can be joined from locked.jsonl at report time (counts only)
feedback_on_locked: Feedback teach/annotation/neighbour sets are NOT drawn from the locked exam. They use non-locked s1_pool/s1_dev/s3_dev (PREREG_*.json holds the teach ids + sha256 written before any edit). Locked TOOLSEL is used only for the post-feedback retention check (>=98% of stage-1 correct).
